summary.scope: Non-transactional supplied accounting; observed labels are user assertions, not authenticated receipts. Customer savings are not revenue. No funds, authority or capability improvement are created.

comparison.scope: Conditional equal-acceptance scenario using supplied wage and duration assumptions; remaining customer attention is distinct from provider costs.

boundary: The canonical API records money only. CPU/wall resources retain physical units in their separate ledger; they are not inserted as dollars or monetized without a tariff. This is one study account, not additive per-asset duplication.
